HFSP Long Term Fellowship 2025 is an opportunity provided by the Human Frontier Science Program (HFSP)* to international students. It aims to provide fellows with an opportunity to develop their expertise in the life sciences, expand their international network, and build interdisciplinary collaborations. Selected fellows will receive a fellowship for 3 years.

*The Human Frontier Science Program is implemented by the International Human Frontier Science Program Organisation (HFSPO) with its office in Strasbourg to fund frontier research in the life sciences.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
begin their fellowship between 1 April 2026 and 1 January 2027
have completed a Ph.D. or a comparable doctoral degree with equivalent research experience before starting their fellowship and before 31 December 2026
propose a basic, fundamental research topic within the field of life science that is distinctly different from their Ph.D. or previous postdoctoral work
have at least one full-length, original research publication as a lead/single author, first author, or shared/joint author
Applicants must apply for a fellowship other than India (country of nationality).
Applicants with dual nationality can apply to work at an institution in one of their countries of nationality, if they have never studied or worked in that country.

Documents required during the submission of the letter of intent:
Personal information (name, ORCID ID, email, degrees, short CV)
Proposed host institution and host supervisor(s), and intended arrival date at the host institution
Disclosure of any previous or current collaborations (if any) with the proposed host supervisor(s)
Title and abstract of PhD thesis, and title and abstract of previous postdoctoral projects (if any)
A summary of the proposed research plan
Confirmation that the host supervisor(s) are aware of, and support, the application
Documents required during full proposal submission:
Recommendation letter from the proposed host supervisor(s)
Reference letters from two additional referees
Contact information for the host institution's official and host supervisor(s) to enable access to the proposal
A public summary of the proposed project (up to 2400 characters)
Signatures of the applicant, the host supervisor(s), and the designated host institution official

The full proposal must contain completed sessions by the host supervisor(s) and referees must have submitted their sections, and be signed by them along with the host institution officials.

The letters of intent will be assessed for eligibility, and selected applicants will be invited to submit a full proposal by mid to end of August 2025. Both the letter and proposal will undergo a peer review process.
